content.title: No model resolves more than a quarter of SWE-EVO
content.source: SWE-EVO, arXiv:2512.18470 (v5), Table 2 · OpenHands scaffold · 48 tasks, avg 21 files and 874 tests per task

altText: Horizontal bar chart of SWE-EVO success rates for eight coding models under the OpenHands scaffold. gpt-5.4 leads at 25.00% of tasks resolved, followed by kimi-k2p5 at 22.92% and deepseek-v3p2 at 20.83%, down to gpt-5-nano-08-07 at 4.17%. The axis runs to 100%, so every bar sits in the left quarter of the frame, showing that no model resolves more than a quarter of long-horizon software evolution tasks.
